description:
Creates a new account

HTTP: POST /v1/accounts
Category: Accounts
Required scopes: accounts:write
Returns: {status, data: object {id, username, email, full_name, phone, role, status, two_factor_enabled, password_strength_score, avatar, ui_preferences, created_by, … (+14 more)}, message}
Mutating: changes server state.

auto_username.description: When true and the username is taken, the first free readable variant is used (blog → blog2); the response carries the name actually created

email.description: Contact e-mail address of the account owner

plan_id.description: UUID of the hosting plan that sets the account's limits — obtain it from GET /v1/plans

username.description: Login name of the new hosting account (unique on the panel)

name: panelica_accounts_post_v1_accounts
